import requests

def get_synonyms(name):
    url = f"https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/{name}/synonyms/JSON"
    r = requests.get(url)
    if r.status_code == 200:
        syns = r.json()['InformationList']['Information'][0]['Synonym']
        print(f"Synonyms for {name} (first 10):", syns[:10])
    else:
        print(f"Failed for {name}")

get_synonyms("Androstenonol propionate")
